liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Reviewer calls Playin' a highlight of the month [9]
- **Candyman** (1 review): Jerry's guitar tone on Candyman is praised, especially a slow, steady, vibrato-heavy solo [10]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): The jam after Weather Report Suite into Wharf Rat has an exotic touch [12]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Reviewer says the Dew alone justifies downloading the show [8]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-03-26.sbd.miller.34787.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 31 songs; 235 min; rated 4.82/5 by 28 [1]. Said about its sound: The last few notes of Looks Like Rain are cut; reel flips affect Here Comes Sunshine, the Truckin' jam and Morning Dew [1]
- **gd73-03-26.sbd.miller-ashley.1373.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 31 songs; 234 min; rated 4.14/5 by 22 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound good, judging from six first-set songs heard so far; Reviewer calls the sound quality great; Jerry sounds good in the mix, though his vocals are slightly off [7][8][11][14]
- **gd1973-03-26.170436.sbd-set2patched.miller.lamarre.andrewf.vernon.flegel.flac1644**: soundboard; 16 songs; 125 min [3]
- **gd1973-03-26.170348.aud.lamarre.vernon.AndrewF.flac2496**: audience recording; 7 songs; 81 min [4]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Wolfman Jack [1]
- The first two tracks are mislabeled in the files; they are actually Promised Land and Half-Step, in correct order [7]
- Wolfman Jack introduces the band before the second set, which opens straight into Ramble On Rose [9]
- The band returned to Baltimore six months after the 9-17-72 show, which the reviewer calls legendary [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-03-26.sbd.miller.34787.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [1]. Also: Source is a DAT from Steve Rolfe; disc changes are seamless [1]
- **gd73-03-26.sbd.miller-ashley.1373.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Lineage runs soundboard to master reel to DAT to CD to EAC to SHN, via Charlie Miller and Jay Ashley [2]
- **gd1973-03-26.170436.sbd-set2patched.miller.lamarre.andrewf.vernon.flegel.flac1644**: source: Patched set 2 soundboard [3]. Also: Reel flips in the Truckin' jam and Morning Dew were patched using a newly circulated audience source from Lamarre, Andrew F and Vernon [3]
- **gd1973-03-26.170348.aud.lamarre.vernon.AndrewF.flac2496**: source: Analog Audience Source: Unknown mic/deck/generation/taper Medium Stock Brands: Maxell Epitaxial XLII-90 (70 uS EQ) Dolby Not specified Tape provided by Doug… [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Baltimore Civic Center - March 26, 1973](https://www.dead.net/show/march-26-1973) [25]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Dave's Picks Vol. 54: Baltimore Civic Center, Baltimore, MD 3/26/73](https://store.dead.net/products/daves-picks-vol-54-baltimore-civic-center-baltimore-md-3-26-73?variant=42765724680234) [26]
- Poster by Doug Collette: [Grateful Dead: Dave's Picks Volume 54 - Baltimore Civic Center, Baltimore MD 3/26/73 (ALBUM REVIEW) - Glide Magazine](https://glidemagazine.com/312645/grateful-dead-daves-picks-volume-54-baltimore-civic-center-baltimore-md-3-26-73-album-review/) [27]
